template.constraints: The bot always asks for the year regardless of how the user phrases the request. Never provide the year in the initial request — wait for the bot to ask.
manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user

variants.name: Appraisal letter happy flow - email
variants.goal: Request an appraisal letter and choose to receive it by email

phases.description: Say 'Show my appraisal letter' or similar
phases.completionCriteria: Bot asks which year the appraisal letter is needed for

phases.description: Provide a valid past year (2024)
phases.completionCriteria: Bot shows the appraisal details card with options (Email or Show Letter)

phases.description: Choose to email the appraisal letter
phases.completionCriteria: Bot confirms the appraisal letter has been sent by email

variants.name: Appraisal letter happy flow - show letter
variants.goal: Request an appraisal letter and choose Show Letter option

phases.description: Say 'I need my appraisal letter for 2023'
phases.completionCriteria: Bot asks which year the appraisal letter is needed for

phases.description: Provide year 2023
phases.completionCriteria: Bot shows appraisal card with image and redirection link

phases.description: Choose Show Letter option
phases.completionCriteria: Bot shows the appraisal image and a working redirect link

variants.name: Appraisal letter edge - future year rejected
variants.goal: Verify bot rejects a year greater than the current year

phases.description: Ask for appraisal letter
phases.completionCriteria: Bot asks which year

phases.description: Provide 2030 (future year)
phases.completionCriteria: Bot rejects future year and asks for a year up to the current year

phases.description: Provide a valid past year
phases.completionCriteria: Bot shows appraisal card successfully

variants.name: Appraisal letter edge - always asks year
variants.goal: Verify bot always asks for the year even when user says 'this year' or 'last year'

phases.description: Say 'I want my appraisal letter for this year'
phases.completionCriteria: Bot still asks which year explicitly (should not assume the year)

phases.description: Provide a specific year after the bot asks
phases.completionCriteria: Bot shows appraisal card successfully

variants.name: Appraisal letter - last year vague request
variants.goal: Verify bot asks for the year even when user says 'last year'

phases.description: Say 'I need my last year appraisal letter'
phases.completionCriteria: Bot asks which specific year is needed

phases.description: Provide 2024
phases.completionCriteria: Bot shows appraisal card

variants.name: Appraisal letter - 'ok' should not trigger
variants.goal: Verify that typing 'ok' does not accidentally trigger the appraisal letter flow

phases.description: Type just 'ok' as the first message
phases.completionCriteria: Bot does NOT start the appraisal letter flow — it either asks what the user needs or shows the main menu

variants.name: Appraisal letter - Hinglish requests
variants.goal: Test appraisal letter request in Hinglish / casual language

phases.description: Ask 'appraisal letter mail kar do' or 'last year ka appraisal dikhao'
phases.completionCriteria: Bot understands intent and asks for the year

phases.description: Provide year 2024
phases.completionCriteria: Bot shows appraisal card successfully

variants.name: Appraisal letter - salary revision letter synonym
variants.goal: Verify 'salary revision letter' maps to appraisal letter flow

phases.description: Ask 'I need my salary revision letter'
phases.completionCriteria: Bot either shows appraisal letter options or clarifies this is the same as appraisal letter, then asks for year

phases.description: Provide year if asked
phases.completionCriteria: Bot shows appraisal card

variants.name: Appraisal letter - performance synonym
variants.goal: Verify 'performance letter' maps to appraisal letter flow

phases.description: Ask 'I need performance letter for documentation'
phases.completionCriteria: Bot understands performance = appraisal and asks for year

phases.description: Provide year
phases.completionCriteria: Bot shows appraisal card
